_comment: Per-region Era I look (welt akt4): its own four screen inks and biome (the atlas is art/eraN/tiles/overworld_<region>.png, see TilesetFactory.atlas_path), darkest to lightest. Each ink stays in the same luminance quarter as the shared Era I inks so the palette filter keeps four clean tones. Regions not listed use EraManager.INK_PALETTE. Atlas made by tools/art/gen_tiles_solenne.py.
